items.title: Lost Island
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
You are stranded on a lost island looking for food and answers to your questions. A small village which is inhabited by monks shows you the history of the island. But be warned, there is a huge curse on the island, dark creatures are up to mischief.

+ Storyline
+ Caves
+ Dungeon
+ Island

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Safest Billionaire Mansion
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Challenge your friends to get past the many traps of probably the safest billionaire mansion you've ever seen! Not only are you protected from diamond thieves, but you can also enjoy a monster-free zone!

- Great for role play 
- Safe billionaire mansion 
- Chests full of good equipment
- By RareLoot

items.title: The Lost Colosseum
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Behold the long lost colosseum, once a centre of the city of illusions, and yearning, chosen by the great explorers. Lose yourself in the ancient buildings and find the many hidden treasures that remain forgotten.

- Stunning survival spawn
- By RareLoot

items.title: Floating Farmers
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Farming looks mighty easy when your plough is a pencil and you're a thousand miles from the cornfield. So take your elytra and become a farmer who faithfully plants seeds in the Spring and who reaps a harvest in Autumn whilst enjoying the endless beauty of the skies.

- Survival spawn
- Includes multiple different farms.
- By RareLoot

items.title: Secret Millionaire Base
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Are you ready to explore your epic secret base hidden underneath your million dollars mansion? Then this is the map for you! Deep underground, you'll find everything you'll need to have the time of your life and look cool while doing it!

- Includes secret bunker
- Great for role-play
- Stunning survival spawn
- By RareLoot

items.title: Demon Evolution
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
These demons have undergone an epic evolution which has made them even more powerful and given them new and mysterious powers! Unlock them and frighten your friends with these cool fantasy skins!

- 12 Demon skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Pretty Cute Patterns
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These patterns sure are cute! There a lots of designs and colors for you to choose from in this skin pack. Which skin will you choose?

- 13 skins

items.title: Crazy Aliens!
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
They are wacky and come from the far reaches of the galaxy! They have come to earth for a great time and are ready to party and maybe want to destroy the planet too! Join in on the fun with the Crazy Aliens skin-pack!

- 12 skins
- By Geniely

items.title: Roman Empire
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Will you lead a legion into battle fighting against the barbarians? Will you be victorious in the arena in a battle for your life? Will you command the vast lands of the roman empire as its powerful leader? Choose your adventure as either a soldier, gladiator or emperor with this amazing skin pack!

- 12 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Incredible Champions
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Be the hero of the story! Surround yourself with powerful champions in the world and live by the highest standards. Can you be at the top of the squad? Become the most successful teen in town and get ready to impress everyone with grace and style all your own!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Trendy Squad
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Get ready! The trendy squad arrived in town and is ready for some action. Jump through the buildings wearing your new outfit and become the fittest of them all. Robust is a small word for them because they are the definition of incredible actions. Don't be too afraid and join them!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 skins 
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Imma Bee
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
I'mma, I'mma, I'mma bee! Black and yellow, rocking that style! Sweet and cute, just like a bee! #SaveTheBees

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Modern, luxury attire!

items.title: Teen Zoo Onesies
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
A new group of teens are wilding out right now in some new zoo animal onesies! They're so cute and cuddly!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Modern, cozy attire!

items.title: Teen Challengers
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
A new challenger approaches! I've heard they've been undefeated throughout their championship campaign! Who could they be? Let's find out!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Modern, luxury attire!

items.title: Lucky Blocks Camp Kira
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
A camping trip has never been more fun! Welcome to Camp Kira where the fun runs wild! Test your luck at a new set of lucky blocks and find out if you're really lucky! 

- 10 lucky blocks!
- Over 100 lucky or unlucky events!
- Custom massive survival spawn!
- Deep caves to explore!
- 6 new skins!

items.title: Hollows
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Darkness taken in the form of monsters that roam in the night. Be careful of where you walk. These mindless beasts have but one interest: to consume your soul.

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Demon and monster attire!

items.title: Shinigami
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
The reaper of souls. The takers of the doomed. The balancers of equilibrium. These are the descriptions of those who walk between worlds. They are known as shinigami.

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Fantasy, Japanese attire!

items.title: Hacker Weapons
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Hacked items are among us! Survive in a modern, millionaire, underground base with the most powerful weapons and tools in Minecraft. Use these crazy weapons to become a legend in your survival world! They're a bunch of fun!

- Hacked weapons and armor
- Hacked Blocks!
- Decorated rooms!
- Play with friends!

items.title: Millionaire Waterfall Mansion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Millionaire Waterfall Mansion is a modern base designed around a beautiful waterfall with everything a millionaire needs! From fun rooms to a pool, this mansion has a bunch for you to share with your friends! Explore all the luxury this survival world has to offer.

- Mega mansion
- Modern design with waterfall features
- Great with friends!

items.title: Lucky Blocks!
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Lucky blocks have random outcomes with good and bad possibilities. Test your luck and you might get diamonds! If you're unlucky, be careful of accidentally spawning a wither!

items.title: Neko Teens
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Be a neko teen! Meow! UwU

+ 10 neko teen skins!
+ Roleplay ready!
+ owo!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Strange Creatures
items.creator: Box Build
items.description:
Now you can be just as scary as a creeper. Now is the time to become a creature and surprise your friends with your strange and unique look.

+ Includes 8 different skins to choose from.

By Kuboc Studios.

items.title: Gorillas Vs Lizards
items.creator: Box Build
items.description:
An epic clash between titans! Become a mighty millennial beast with great style for all occasions. 5 lizard skins and 5 gorilla skins with unique and different outfits.

+ Includes 10 different skins.
+ Created by Kuboc Studios.

items.title: Anime Pets
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description: Do you love pet animals? Do you love anime? These cute and cuddly Anime Pets are perfect for you!
